about: Checks the mod reports in a Melty test run (recipe test.checks). In test mode it picks Mina, starts a run and fires her Noita wand by itself; each run the wand holds a different group (testWands).

rows.passes: Noita's data.wak, gun_actions.lua and translations were read from NOITA_DIR
every spells.json and modifiers.json row became its own Magicraft spell with Noita's numbers
set 13 and wands 9131/9132 are registered and unlocked
a Noita spell icon was served as a Sprite
a Noita spell in a wand slot resolves to itself (its own id, Noita name and icon), not to a Magicraft spell
Mina's Noita frames are drawn on the player
Noita spells are in the run's spell drop pool alongside Magicraft's own
a wand slot holding a Noita spell fired it
the spell entity is its own Spell_<id> and is drawn with Noita's sprite
a Noita projectile bounced and lost Noita's bounce energy
an exploding Noita spell (Firebolt) blew up with Noita's explosion
a sound decoded from Noita's own sound bank played
no game exception was logged during the run
the game aims (and turns the wand) where the test points
the Noita wand in Mina's hand points where she aims (within 15 degrees), right, up, left and down, like Magicraft's wands

testWands.about: test mode only: Mina's first wand holds a different group each run (Melty runs 3), left to right; modifiers change the projectile after them

combos.about: test mode: after the run's own wand, Mina's first wand is set to each combo in turn and fired (aimed, held down) for its seconds. Each passes when the wand cast it and no game error or exception was logged meanwhile.

columns.slots: wand slots left to right (Noita newBase*10+1 or Magicraft spell ids)
columns.seconds: how long the cast button is held

rows.why: Noita Damage Plus on Noita Triplicate Bolt, held fire (the reported crash)
Noita Homing + Bounce on Magicraft Magic Bullet
Magicraft Rebound + Damage Boost on Noita Spark Bolt
Noita Double Spell on Magicraft Star Bomb, Divide by 2 on Magic Bullet
Magicraft Multicast on Firebolt, Split on Bouncing Burst
Heavy Shot + Speed Up on Magicraft Laser
Magicraft Volley over Triplicate Bolt, Magic Bullet and Spark Bolt
